reasons.tasks: Tasks keep every control, review and follow-up assigned and on time.
reasons.context: Every ISO management system starts with clauses 4 and 5: context, interested parties, scope and leadership.
reasons.processes: The process approach (ISO 9001 4.4) asks you to define and control your key processes.
reasons.deviations: Handling nonconformities and incidents (clause 10.2) is required by every standard you chose.
reasons.risk: Risk-based thinking (clause 6.1) and, for ISO 27001, the risk assessment and SoA are mandatory.
reasons.inspections: Inspections give you the monitoring evidence that clause 9.1 asks for.
reasons.audits: Internal audits (clause 9.2) are required before any certification audit.
reasons.management_review: Top management must review the management system at planned intervals (clause 9.3).
reasons.objectives: Measurable objectives (clause 6.2) show that the system is improving.
reasons.people: Competence and awareness (clauses 7.2 and 7.3) must be planned and recorded.
reasons.recruitment: Screening before employment is an ISO 27001 control (A.6.1), and candidate data falls under GDPR.
reasons.training: Training records prove competence, and the AI Act requires AI literacy (Art. 4).
reasons.contracts: Supplier agreements and data processing agreements are required by ISO 27001 A.5.20 and GDPR Art. 28.
reasons.suppliers: External providers must be evaluated and monitored (ISO 9001 8.4, ISO 27001 A.5.19).
reasons.projects: Planned changes and design work (ISO 9001 6.3 and 8.3) are easier to control as projects.
reasons.privacy: GDPR requires records of processing, DPIAs and a 72-hour breach process.
reasons.ai_governance: ISO/IEC 42001 and the EU AI Act require an inventory, classification and impact assessments of AI systems.
reasons.environment: ISO 14001 asks you to evaluate environmental aspects and monitor your performance.
reasons.obligations: Every standard asks you to know and evaluate the legal and other requirements that apply.
reasons.assets: An asset inventory and access control are core ISO 27001 controls (A.5.9 to A.5.18).
reasons.continuity: ISO 27001 (A.5.29 and A.5.30) and NIS2 require continuity planning and testing.
reasons.hse: ISO 45001 requires hazard identification and worker consultation.
reasons.feedback: ISO 9001 9.1.2 asks you to monitor customer satisfaction.
reasons.reports: Reports and audit packs make it quick to show evidence to auditors.
reasons.documents: Documented information must be controlled (clause 7.5) in every ISO standard.
reasons.standards: The standards workspace shows how each requirement of your standards is met.
